intent: Android Agent survives a Viewer connection request while waiting in background.
rollback: Revert this change before release; after publication ship a higher fixed version without deleting registration data.

requestReview.reason: Preserves WebRTC JNI names during R8 shrinking and uses API26-compatible string validation. Adds local release-artifact checks only; no network timers, listeners, retries or database changes.

outcomes.acceptance: PC Viewer Connect while Android Agent is in background does not terminate the Agent; consent and approved first-frame delivery remain available.

Native verifier rejects existing release mapping (WebRTC JNI class changed). :agent:testDebugUnitTest --tests com.wonremote.agent.ControlAddonClientTest and :controladdon:compileDebugJavaWithJavac passed in 5s. outcomes.physicalGap: Reproduce reported crash with logcat on affected device, then verify signed optimized APK background request, permission refusal, approval, first frame, disconnect and repeated connection on arm64/armv7. No build requested.
